title: AlternativeRootProposal
description: After an AC reject_and_diversify, the Professor proposes N>=3 alternative root claim angles for the system to explore in parallel or serially. Each angle must come from a different axis (operational, taste, mechanism, inverted-validity, different-method) to avoid linear retry of the same direction.

previous_attempt_root.description: Brief recap of the just-rejected root claim so future attempts can be checked for non-overlap.

alternatives.description: At least 3 distinct angle alternatives. Each must target a different axis from the previous attempt — no near-rephrasings.

angle.description: Which axis this alternative attacks. Used to enforce diversification — the set of N alternatives must cover >=3 distinct angle values.

rationale.description: Why this alternative is non-trivially different from the rejected root.

why_this_angle.description: Why this specific axis (e.g. 'operational' or 'inverted_validity') is the right angle for this problem class given the rebuttal evidence.
